[1] is an American concert television special featuring live performances by Tony Bennett and Lady Gaga in support of their collaborative studio album, "Cheek to Cheek", released in September 2014.
[2] Tony Bennett's "Something" is a 1970 studio album by Tony Bennett.
[3] "Something" was the first Harrison composition to appear as a Beatles A-side, and the only song written by him to top the US charts before the band's break-up in April 1970.
